description:
Turns a chosen market into signed-ready calldata: an ordered list of transactions to deposit into it or leave it, across Morpho vaults, Aave reserves, Moonwell markets and this project's staking pools — three different protocol interfaces behind one call. The approve step is included only when the current allowance does not already cover the amount, read on-chain at request time.

Use this once a market has been chosen and the decision is made.

Use something else when: still choosing (`list_lending_vaults`, `best_yield`); weighing whether to go ahead (`market_profile`, `yield_history`).

Nothing is signed or sent — the caller holds the keys. Simulate before sending. `amount: "all"` on a withdrawal exits by share rather than by figure, so interest accruing between the call and the block is not left behind.

amount.description: Whole asset units, e.g. '25.5' — or 'all' to exit a position completely

from.description: The address that will sign and hold the position

name: build_deposit
